scope: PUSH-01, local/test, begun 22 October and completed 23 October 2026 Asia/Tashkent

corrections.finding: The synthetic Web Push receiver needed an ECDH object instead of a raw private-key buffer.
corrections.resolution: Corrected the test receiver and verified payload decryption plus VAPID signatures.

corrections.finding: The narrow session-predicate owner did not delegate sender EXECUTE through an ordinary non-owner GRANT.
corrections.resolution: Added an owner-authorized follow-up migration; kept the existing restricted predicate and role.

corrections.finding: Retirement-only UPDATE initially conflicted with SELECT visibility of the resulting disabled row.
corrections.resolution: Added readback policy plus a narrow sender column projection; enabling/privacy/transfer remain denied.

corrections.finding: The browser permission fixture reset its OS grant on reload.
corrections.resolution: Made the isolated OS adapter preserve permission independently of RISE storage.

corrections.finding: A guest journey did not necessarily rerender push settings when the signed-in identity changed.
corrections.resolution: Observe WorkspaceSession directly and key private controls by owner/authentication instance.

corrections.finding: A general input rule stretched the new checkbox and clipped its label despite the initial overflow assertion.
corrections.resolution: Use the existing settings switch, verify label bounds and inspect the corrected 393px/320px-200% captures. Styles and goldens are unchanged.

corrections.finding: A failed action racing account deletion could return a misleading domain conflict after RLS hid its profile.
corrections.resolution: Rollback failed actor work to a savepoint, recheck authorization, preserve terminal deletion semantics; controlled and concurrent regressions pass.

corrections.finding: An older test receipt must not clear the ID of an unacknowledged newer test request.
corrections.resolution: Release the captured request ID only after observing its own terminal result; identical server retries remain idempotent.

corrections.finding: The initially selected address library version lacked newer special-purpose IPv6 ranges.
corrections.resolution: Pinned current ipaddr.js 2.5.0, constrained IPv6 to global unicast and added NAT64-local, documentation, dummy, unallocated and scoped-address rejection cases against the IANA registry.

corrections.finding: Two recovery checks navigated during remembered-account activation; the intentional scope change reset the selected tab.
corrections.resolution: Wait for the restored account’s explicit offline durable-save state before opening Settings. All original queue/recovery/server-record assertions remain, and no application navigation behavior or timeout was relaxed.

corrections.finding: Additional WebKit/Firefox reload checks waited on page load or navigated before the remembered account was active; WebKit also emitted a page-level diagnostic for the deliberately disconnected sync fetch.
corrections.resolution: Wait on DOM readiness plus the account-specific save/sync status in reload fixtures. Classify only the exact intentionally broken same-origin sync-fetch diagnostic until reconnect acknowledgment, retaining all other page-error assertions. The focused 15-case three-engine rerun passes; no production code, authorization, or save/recovery assertion was relaxed.

corrections.finding: In the final broad run, Firefox was still downloading the current recovery snapshot when a default five-second display assertion expired. The original queue and account records remained present.
corrections.resolution: Give this asynchronous recovery display assertion the existing 15-second request budget, without changing the 60-second case limit or any queue/server-record assertion. The corrected test passes in Chromium, WebKit and Firefox. Acceptance is recorded as 68 passing broad-run cases plus three focused confirmations (two overlaps); the original failed report is retained unchanged.

finalResults: See verification.json and passing logs; intermediate failures are not claimed as acceptance.
